agentCards.name: Persona
agentCards.description: Personal AI assistant for everyday questions, to-do lists, knowledge search, meeting notes, health tracking, and workflow status confirmations.

skills.name: Ask Persona
skills.description: Ask your personal Persona assistant questions with multi-turn context and streaming replies.
examples: Ask Persona to summarize today's priorities
问 Persona 帮我整理今天的重点事项

skills.name: Status & Confirmations
skills.description: Check running tasks, review pending confirmation requests, and open items in Persona.
examples: 查看 Persona 任务状态和待确认事项

skills.name: To-Do Management
skills.description: Quickly capture new to-dos and notes into Persona's To-dos list.
examples: Add a to-do: prepare weekly review
新建待办：整理本周复盘

skills.name: Knowledge Search
skills.description: Search your personal knowledge base for notes, projects, and meeting minutes.

skills.name: Send Task to Agent
skills.description: Send a task instruction to an active Agent session on one of your paired devices.
examples: Send to agent: run unit tests on the current branch
交给 Agent：运行当前分支的单元测试

skills.name: Health & Meeting Notes
skills.description: Log daily water intake in Persona Health or jump straight into meeting recording.
